raw_text: Repeat engagement with our done-for-you invoicing experience continues to grow, and has increased more than 50% since November.
Our stock has appreciated to approximately $492 per share
We are seeing strong growth across simple and more complex returns as the season progresses and strong overall average revenue per filer.
Total online payment volume growth in Q2 was 18%
We are also seeing more than 3x higher starts on the Credit Karma platform, driven by an increase in the availability of seamless zero-click login to TurboTax from 5% last season to 70% this season.
We estimate that our local experts in 130-plus designated market areas will give us access to approximately 80% of nationwide assisted filers
We processed 2.1 billion transactions in Q4
Just as a reminder, when an expert connects to one of our customers, the conversion rate is 80%.
Total revenue for the Q2 2025 was $2 billion
